name: Read the official Government Plaza spy-capacity prerequisites in the captured game

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local d=b.EnemyRetryDiagnosis(); assert(d.spyID==655368 and d.eventID==0 and d.outcome=='CAPTURED' and d.occupied==1,'actual captive checkpoint differs'); local p=b.CaptiveCapacityPlan(); return p.stage..' capacity='..p.capacity..' occupied='..p.occupied..' city='..tostring(p.cityID)..' building='..tostring(p.buildingType)
